dedupe_keys.name: distribution of eastern indian ocean pygmy blue whales and potential impacts of offshore wind developments nesp mac 4 8

description: Distribution of Eastern Indian Ocean pygmy blue whales and potential impacts of offshore wind developments (NESP MaC 4.8) is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Australian Ocean Data Network. The offshore renewable energy (ORE) sector is rapidly developing in Australian waters to support national carbon emission targets. However, new marine infrastructure can introduce additional risks to threatened species. The eastern Indian Ocean pygmy blue whale (Balaenoptera musculus brevicauda) was identified by the Australian Government as a priority species for assessing potential ORE impacts. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Australian Ocean Data Network. Its tags are National Environmental Science Program (NESP) Marine and Coastal Hub, Offshore wind farms, pygmy blue whale. It offers 12 resource(s) in html, png, wms. The portal shows 2026-09-03 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
